msg: Hi, we're two Americans, both certified, want to do the 2-dive trip from Cartagena next Friday. Can we pay with PayPal or cash when we get there? We don't like paying online.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

PayPal isn’t accepted, and international guests need to pay 100% by card through the website when booking. Cash payment at the dock isn’t available without an online booking. If the online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer link, and the 10% online discount is kept.

For the 2-dive trip from Cartagena, the online price is *USD 178 per person* (10% online discount applied). You can book for next Friday here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.
